lines.text: Your AI writes HTML. Lots of it.
docserve — serve a folder of HTML as a card gallery.
Pick a folder — and there's your gallery.
Every edit shows up on the page — instantly.
You can use docserve as a macOS app, a CLI, or a VS Code extension.
Try docserve. It's free and open-source.
